notes:
Crisp tells you there isn't room before it spends an hour finding out.

If you saved to a drive without space for the finished file, Crisp ran the whole upscale and only failed at the very last step — on a long 4K job that could be hours of work for nothing. It now checks the destination before starting and says how big the render will be and how much room you have. It only speaks when it is certain, so a render that fits still just runs.
